metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Egeon, a loaf a thumb short, and a knot tied four times.

yesterday: You play Egeon. You open the play, and you wait until the end of it.
The Prince, in her hearing, is the only man in the quarrel with sense. You are to play him. Speak up.
The loaf wants a full thumb. The penny is still the penny. By Michaelmas, she says, the board itself.
Thread, shuttle, knot. Alse had it once. Tomorrow is rehearsal at nine, and Richard the Third at two, and you are in the king.
